{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool-blend blazer, tailored fit, knee-length cut, #1e2325 color, heavy textured fabric.
Cream silk blouse, relaxed fit, hem falling at waistline, #e3c3a2 color, smooth fluid fabric.
High-waisted black wide-leg trousers, straight cut, ankle length, #0f0f0f color, soft stretch cotton fabric.
Black leather ankle boots, pointed toe, mid-calf height, #0a0a0a color, genuine leather material.

This outfit perfectly balances the request for restraint and classic style while remaining suitable for standing in a crowded venue during an evening event. The dark neutral palette of charcoal and black creates a streamlined silhouette that looks polished without being overly flashy under artificial club lighting. The structured blazer adds a layer of sophistication appropriate for the smart dress code, while the silk blouse introduces a subtle touch of warmth and texture against the cooler autumn air."}
